releases.name: Subpool v0.3.0
releases.notes_html:
Highlights

  • Route Codex built-in image generation and edit requests through bound Codex subscription accounts, using existing Responses-scoped API keys and mixed-pool failover without buffering large image payloads.
  • Surface fresh GitHub Copilot and Codex subscription credit snapshots to Codex through HTTP and SSE response headers and Responses WebSocket rate-limit events.
  • Display Codex AI credit balances alongside five-hour and weekly capacity in the account console.

Reliability and operations

  • Preserve long-lived Responses WebSockets by clearing inherited HTTP read deadlines after connection upgrades while retaining per-message timeouts.
  • Keep quota freshness metadata available across API key, pinned-account, and WebSocket routing so credit updates reach the final routed account after failover.
  • Record image token usage and preserve subscription routing behavior across image generation and edit requests.

Documentation

  • Document Codex subscription image endpoints and their existing API key scope.

Upgrade notes

Pull public.ecr.aws/cloudpilotai/subpool:v0.3.0 for the stable image. No new database migrations are included since v0.2.0. Existing Codex, GitHub Copilot, and OpenAI-compatible configurations remain supported.

releases.name: Subpool v0.2.0
releases.notes_html:
Highlights

  • Add GitHub Copilot as a subscription provider with device OAuth, model discovery, account health, and AI credits visibility.
  • Support Copilot through both Chat Completions and the native Responses API, with model-aware endpoint routing and mixed-pool failover.
  • Bridge function, custom, namespaced, tool-search, multimodal, structured-output, refusal, and streaming error semantics across compatible endpoints.
  • Publish a dedicated release page with stable version history, immutable image coordinates, source revisions, and release notes.

Reliability and operations

  • Isolate Responses WebSocket sessions and improve quota-aware failover, cooldown recovery, request ordering, and process cleanup.
  • Support larger buffered requests and longer upstream model responses with bounded, configurable limits.
  • Refresh Codex quota against the official source, preserve quota freshness during probe failures, and surface five-hour usage.
  • Generate typed store queries and scope assignment locks to strengthen concurrent routing behavior.

Console and usage

  • Add employee usage summaries and paginated usage details while keeping API keys out of usage views.
  • Improve account connection, quota, reset-credit, and provider-status workflows.
  • Precompress web assets and update the bundled Codex CLI for GPT-6 models.

Upgrade notes

Pull public.ecr.aws/cloudpilotai/subpool:v0.2.0 for the stable image. Database migrations 016 through 018 are applied automatically during startup. Existing Codex and OpenAI-compatible configurations remain supported.

releases.name: Subpool v0.1.0
releases.notes_html:
Highlights

  • Pool Codex subscription and OpenAI-compatible accounts behind employee API keys.
  • Route Responses API, Chat Completions, and Responses WebSocket traffic with account affinity and health-aware failover.
  • Keep a stable Codex device identity per account and optionally enforce Fast mode at the account level.
  • Manage accounts, pools, API keys, quota, reset credits, health, and usage from the web console.
  • Deploy with Docker Compose using published multi-architecture images from Amazon ECR Public.

Getting started

Follow the installation and Codex configuration instructions in the README. Database migrations are applied automatically during startup.

Compatibility

This is the first public release. Configuration and database upgrades within the 0.1 series will preserve the documented deployment path.
